claims.claim_ar: تكرار فعل الأمر «أَطِيعُوا» مرتين (أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ) — تكرير الكلام لتأكيد الأمر وتقوية الالتزام.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the imperative 'أَطِيعُوا' (twice: 'Obey Allah and obey the Messenger') — repetition (takrīr) used to emphasize and reinforce the command.
claims.rhetorical_effect: strengthens exhortation and makes the duty more emphatic by immediate reiteration

claims.claim_ar: الواو العاطفة تربط الأوامر المتعاقبة («وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ وَاحْذَرُوا») وتؤدي إلى تتابع معنوي يُشعر بالاستمرار والتراكم في الواجب.
claims.claim_en: The coordinating waw functioning as 'ʿāṭifah' links the successive imperatives ('Obey Allah, obey the Messenger, and beware'), producing a cumulative/continuous sequence of commands.
claims.needs_review_reason: grammatical connector can be read as neutral syntax or as a rhetorical device; judgment depends on rhetorical vs. purely syntactic reading
claims.rhetorical_effect: gives sense of continuity and accumulation of duties, linking obligations into a single behavioral sequence

claims.claim_ar: الفاء في «فَإِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَاعْلَمُوا» تعمل رابطة لجواب الشرط، تربط حال التولّي بنتيجة التحذير والبيان (اعلموا ما يلي)، فتُبرز الجزاء والتحذير.
claims.claim_en: The particle fa in 'fa-in tawallaytum fa-'alamū' functions as the connector to the response/result of the condition, linking the turning away to the ensuing admonition and consequence — emphasizing result/penalty.
claims.needs_review_reason: interpretation combines grammatical role of particles with rhetorical effect; some scholars may treat this as grammatical linkage rather than an independent rhetorical trope
claims.rhetorical_effect: signals consequence and sharpens the warning by clearly linking the condition to its outcome
